# servfail_zone (Data Source)

Reads a single DNS zone and all of its RRsets from SERVFAIL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a single zone and all of its RRsets
data "servfail_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com."
}

output "example_serial" {
  value = data.servfail_zone.example.serial
}

output "example_rrsets" {
  value = data.servfail_zone.example.rrsets
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Canonical zone name including the trailing dot.

### Read-Only

- `dnssec` (Boolean) Whether the zone is DNSSEC-signed.
- `kind` (String) Zone kind.
- `nsec3narrow` (Boolean) Whether NSEC3 narrow mode is enabled.
- `nsec3param` (String) NSEC3PARAM contents.
- `rrsets` (Attributes List) All resource record sets in the zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rrsets))
- `serial` (Number) SOA serial.

<a id="nestedatt--rrsets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rrsets`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) RRset name.
- `records` (Attributes List) Record values within the RRset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rrsets--records))
- `ttl` (Number) RRset TTL.
- `type` (String) RRset type.

<a id="nestedatt--rrsets--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rrsets.records`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String) Record value.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether disabled.
